name: aigpu-b2-tile
description: Pre-silicon RTL-verifiable 4-core compute tile & MPW slice for aigpu-b2 (1 cluster x 4 RV64X cores, 8W x 8T, IW=2, TFR/WGMMA/FP16/TF32/FP8/FP4/MX/INT8/SPARSE/DXA/MUFU, graphics disabled; NOT measured physical silicon).

sources.evidence_status: PRE-SILICON RTL-VERIFIABLE COMPUTE TILE SLICE ONLY: 4-core MPW/RTL verification slice for rtlsim, Verilator, Yosys, and OpenROAD (~12-18 mm^2 N4P estimate); NOT measured physical silicon and NOT full 128-core aigpu-b2 SoC closure.
sources.xlen: 64-bit RV64IMAFD machine (configure --profile=aigpu-b2-tile selects build64 and build32 rejects the profile).
sources.NUM_CLUSTERS, NUM_CORES, SOCKET_SIZE: 1 cluster x 4 cores in a single 4-core socket (RTL-bounded verification slice: NUM_CORES == SOCKET_SIZE = 4).
sources.NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH: 8 warps x 8 threads per core, 2 issue slices (TCU geometry: 4x2x2 block, 8x8x8 WMMA tile, 2 TCU blocks x 8 lanes/core).
sources.LMEM_ENABLE, L2_ENABLE, L2_SIZE: Default 16 KiB shared LMEM (LMEM_LOG_SIZE=14 <= 18 WGMMA limit, 8 banks) plus shared 256 KiB write-back L2 cache (262144 B, 8 ways, 128 B lines => 256 sets); B2 tile architectural target scales to 1 MiB TMEM (256 KiB/core) and 1.5 MiB L1/L2.
sources.FPU_TYPE, EXT_TCU_ENABLE, TCU_TYPE, TCU_: Native STD scalar FPU and TFR tensor cores (zero DPI substitution) enabling WGMMA, FP16/BF16, TF32, FP8/BF8, FP4/MX/MXFP4/NVFP4, INT8, 2:4 structured sparsity, DXA async DMA, MUFU transcendentals, and RV64A atomics. VX_CFG_TCU_FEDP2K stays at its VX_config.toml false default on the tile slice so stock rtlsim demo and sgemm_tcu remain 100% buildable without setup-uop divergence.
sources.EXT_TEX_ENABLE, EXT_RASTER_ENABLE, EXT_O: Explicitly false: graphics and ray-tracing units removed in the AI-only tile slice to match aigpu-b2 pruning.
sources.reference: Modeled analytical baseline from resolved defaults (64 FP32 lanes = 4 cores x 2 issue blocks x 8 FPU lanes; default VX_config.toml platform 400 MHz and 460 GB/s; 4 cores; 8 TCU blocks total) checked by ci/profile_check.py --metrics=peak. Scaled @ 2.0 GHz B2 TFRv2 target is ~18 / 36 / 72 TFLOPS (FP16 / FP8 / FP4; 2x 2:4 sparse). Explicitly NOT measured FPGA or silicon hardware.
